description.value: Paradise makes its offer directly, through you, in the target's own voice. Critical Success no effect — and Paradise now knows the target's name, which the GM should write down. Success 10d10 mental damage. Failure it refuses and is stunned 1 and fleeing, and takes 10d10 mental damage. Critical Failure the target accepts, and is uploaded permanently. Declared Signal, you gain 1 Signal Drift whether the spell succeeds or fails — it notices who keeps making the offer for it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Complex outcome table (mental damage/stun/uploaded on various results); Signal: 1 Signal Drift regardless of success or failure. A real, unconditional number riding on the unbuildable Drift track; the damage/stun/uploaded outcomes are otherwise damage-pipeline/out-of-scope. The 0-10 Signal Drift track has the same absence as Bandwidth: no `SpecialResource`/counter representation anywhere in the corpus.
